q: The Karchmer–Wigderson relation KW_f connects circuit depth to communication complexity by:
opts: depth(f) = D^{rel}(KW_f) (depth equals the communication complexity of the search problem: find coordinate where f⁻¹(1) and f⁻¹(0) inputs differ)
exp: KW theorem: the minimum depth of a circuit computing f equals the communication complexity of the relation KW_f (Alice holds x∈f⁻¹(1), Bob holds y∈f⁻¹(0), they find i with xᵢ≠yᵢ). This reduces depth lower bounds to communication lower bounds.
